title: Veggie Elder trades file
description: The Veggie Elder's trades, read from game_task.ovl. Each hunting ground he trades on has its own list; he takes the first item on it that the hunter carries and gives the common or the rare trade for it.

rare_chance.description: In percent: how often a trade gives the rare item. Felyne Negotiations makes it always.

give.description: The item the Elder takes; item ID, as in data/items.json

common.description: What he usually gives for it

rare.description: What he gives on a rare trade

maps.description: The maps this list is used on, by map ID as in quests

trades.description: In the game's order: the first one the hunter has an item for is the one he takes
